Job Description

Jan Dils, Attorneys at Law has helped thousands of people get the benefits they deserve. We have proudly served as a voice for the disabled individual for over 25 years. Our practice has a dynamic culture, and we strive to find applicants who are committed to growth and success. Join an outstanding organization with a client-centered focus and a team of people who fight to make a difference.

Are you detail-oriented? Do you like reading and summarizing what you read? Do you enjoy research? Do you want to help veterans get the benefits that they so very deserve? Then the Remote Claims File Review Specialist might be the right position for you!

What you will be doing as a Remote Claims File Review Specialist:

  • Become an expert on our Case Management Software, Adobe, and Microsoft Office that you will be using daily
  • We’re very goal-oriented at our firm. Once you get the hang of the job, you will review 215 issues every month!
  • We strive to do our very best for our veterans. To do so, the Claims File Reviewer evaluates the rating criteria and research tactics to aid the Veteran in increasing their disability rating for each and every claim.
  • You must have excellent time management skills to consistently lead to the completion of 215 issues per month.
  • This job requires focus! For hours at a time, you will effectively investigate complex technical and medical evidence that support our clients’ VA claims.

Not only is the position itself great, but the benefits we offer are fantastic as well!

Benefits include:

  • You make your own schedule!
  • Remote Work – No commute – Work from home!
  • Community Involvement – Want to get involved in the community but don’t know how? We can help you with that!
  • Positive Organizational Core Values – These values are Client-Centered Focus, Community, Continuous Improvement, Caring, and Collaboration. Our firm is dedicated to and use these values every single day.

Now you might be wondering about the pay?

C-File Review Specialists are paid hourly while they complete new employee orientation and job training. After job training is completed, C-File Review Specialists continue to be compensated at an hourly rate for approximately 2-months, or until job proficiency is demonstrated and a departmental manager approves the employee to be compensated using the “pay-by-review” method. The “Pay-by-Review” method does not assign pay based upon time; it uses total number of page numbers and C-File Review issue counts to determine a base pay for each approved C-File Review. In layman’s terms, the more work you do (as long as it’s error free), the more money you make!

If this sounds like the right job for you, please apply now!

At Jan Dils, Attorneys at Law, we are committed to reflecting the diverse clients and communities in which we serve.

Dr. C Family Dentistry was founded with one intention: to make a positive impact on our team members, patients, and community. We have grown exponentially since 2014, and are so excited to keep making an impact!

Our Vision: Personal and professional growth and advancement. Patient-centered. Building relationships. Ultimate convenience and patient experience. Modern technologies.

Our Culture: Work hard and play hard. Fun at work. Discover and embrace our individual gifts, and then share those with our patients, team members, and families. Celebration and acknowledgment of our achievements.

State-of-the-Art Technology: Biolase diode Epic-H laser therapy, Cavitron-300’s, Nomad x-ray technology, Arrestin therapy, One-click Intra-Oral Camera, TV on the wall and ceilings for patient education and relaxation, Blue Note communication throughout the office, and Open Dental is our PMS.

We are locally owned and operated, with each practice having its own unique touch! We are so thankful to be able to provide versatile treatments for different communities through our practices. Our goal is to find the best fit for YOU!

Do you love being in the Dental field but hate how inflexible an office schedule can be with your personal life? Join our team and enjoy a work/life balance that supports your lifestyle.

Duties

As the federal agency whose mission is to ensure the fair and impartial administration of justice for all Americans, the Department of Justice is committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive work environment. To build and retain a workforce that reflects the diverse experiences and perspectives of the American people, we welcome applicants from the many communities, identities, races, ethnicities, backgrounds, abilities, religions, and cultures of the United States who share our commitment to public service.

Serving as the Community Outreach Specialist in support and assistance to the DEA's Office of Training's community outreach and prevention support activities, including program planning, development, implementation, and evaluation of community events.
Supporting the Office of Training (TR) developing, delivering, and advocating preeminent law enforcement and non-law enforcement training to DEA personnel as well as appropriate federal, state, local, and foreign law enforcement counterparts.
Maintaining a collaborative relationship with DEA Headquarters, other external federal, state and local law enforcement communities and strengthens DEA's presence in the community based network.
Hosting events, providing briefings to academic groups, other law enforcement agencies/groups, and foreign government counterparts.
Establishing and maintaining contact with Office of Training (TR) financial units and works directly with DEA Headquarters' contracting and procurement staff.

You may qualify at the GS-13 level, if you fulfill the following qualification requirement:
One (1) year of specialized experience equivalent to the GS-12 grade level in the Federal Service (or equivalent) performing the following duties: 1) Liaising with prevention organizations and community partners that focus on drug use, family and violence; 2) Analyzing statistical data and budget reports to monitor outcomes and metrics; 3) Formulating and recommending drug prevention communication strategies that include modern approaches such social media presence.

Savanta is a thriving insights, research and data consultancy that informs and inspires clients to Make Better Decisions. Working with high-profile organizations and some of the world’s best-known brands, we offer a full range of integrated intelligence services at global scale – underpinned by sector, audience and methodological expertise – delivered with entrepreneurial spirit and a client-first mindset.


As part of ambitious growth plans, we currently have an opportunity for an eager early career professional to join our growing team.


The Role


As a Research Analyst, you’ll be a critical and foundational piece for the day-to-day management in the delivery of high-quality research projects, applying your knowledge, expertise and analytical skills to support clients in better decision-making. Working across multiple projects simultaneously while reporting to the Project Leads, your core day-to-day responsibilities will involve:


  • Ensuring that our research enables clients to fully meet their objectives;
  • Analyzing the results of the research to create a compelling story and provide strategic recommendations;
  • Presenting engaging presentations, and leading workshops that help ensure our outcomes drive change;
  • Overseeing project tasks carried out by the wider support team – from scripting to fieldwork and supplier management, ensuring project timings and budgets are met;
  • Ensuring accuracy of all client deliverables.

About You


At Savanta, Research Analysts are fast, efficient and accurate workers new to the research industry, who can quickly learn and apply new skills to ensure client objectives will be achieved:


  • A basis for analyzing data to extract pertinent insights and actionable recommendations;
  • Exceptional communication (written and verbal) and interpersonal skills;
